\emph{Use the formulas, $A=P(1+r)^{t}$, $A=P(1+\frac{r}{n})^{nt}$,
or $A=Pe^{rt}$ to problems \ref{enu:first}--\ref{enu:last}.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item \label{enu:first}\renewcommand{\Po}{850} 
\renewcommand{\Ro}{9} 
\renewcommand{\To}{10}
\renewcommand{\Ao}{1}
\FPeval{\Z}{round(\Po*(1+.0\Ro/4)^(4*\To),3)}{[}6 points{]}Find the accumulated value of an investment of \$\Po~at
\Ro\% interest compounded quarterly after \To~ years.\addtocounter{probs}{1}

\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item []$P=\Po,\,r=.0\Ro,\,t=\To,\,\mbox{and }n=4$. So $A=(1+\frac{.0\Ro}{4})^{4\cdot\To}\approx\$\Z$\vfill
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}
\newpage
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item \renewcommand{\Po}{150000} 
\renewcommand{\Ro}{4.5} 
\renewcommand{\To}{15}
\renewcommand{\Ao}{10}
\FPeval{\Z}{round(\Po*(1+.0\Ro/4)^(4*\To),3)}{[}6 points{]} Bob buys a house for \$\Po. The value of the house
grows at a rate of \Ro\% compounded monthly. Find how much the house
is worth after \To~years.

\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item []\renewcommand{\Ro}{45}$P=\Po,\,r=.0\Ro,\,t=\To,\,\mbox{and }n=12$.
So $A=(1+\frac{.0\Ro}{12})^{12\cdot\To}\approx\$\Z$\vfill\addtocounter{probs}{1}
\end{enumerate}
\item \label{enu:last}\renewcommand{\Po}{2000} 
\renewcommand{\Ro}{6.5} 
\renewcommand{\To}{10}
\renewcommand{\Ao}{1}
{[}6 points{]} Suppose Jane has \$\Po~to invest. Which investment
yields the greater return over \To~years: 

\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item []7\% compounded monthly or \Ro\% compounded continuously? Justiy
your answer.\addtocounter{probs}{1}
\end{enumerate}
\begin{itemize}
\item 7\% compounded monthly \\
\FPeval{\Z}{round(\Po*(1+.07/12)^(12*\To),3)}$P=\Po,\,r=.07,\,t=\To,\,\mbox{and }n=12$.
So $A=(1+\frac{.07}{12})^{12\cdot\To}\approx\$\Z$
\item \Ro\% compounded continuously\\
\renewcommand{\Ro}{65}\FPeval{\Z}{round(\Po*e^(.0\Ro*\To),3)}$P=\Po,\,r=.0\Ro,\,t=\To$.
So $A=2000e^{.0\Ro\cdot\To}\approx\$\Z$

\begin{itemize}
\item []So 7\% compounded monthly is better.\vfill
\end{itemize}
\end{itemize}
